usageNotes: Retrieves a single named firewall alias defined at the VM (QEMU guest) level, returning its CIDR value and any comment. Use this to inspect a specific alias before referencing it in firewall rules, or to verify the IP/network it resolves to. Requires VM.Audit on /vms/{vmid}; alias names must start with a letter and be 2–64 characters.

examples.summary: Read the 'WebServers' alias for VM 201 on node pve01

tips: Alias names are case-sensitive and must match the pattern [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+.
VM-level aliases are scoped to the individual VM firewall; they do not exist in the cluster-level alias namespace.
If the alias is not found the API returns a 500-series error, not a 404 — check spelling and scope before assuming it is absent.
Use list_aliases (GET /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/firewall/aliases) first if you are unsure of the exact alias name.
